description: This header file defines interfaces and includes necessary for the ImageHealthChecker component within a software project. It provides function declarations related to client difference detection, reporting, and value retrieval, specific to the ImageHealthChecker module.

methods.name: fnd_cli_diff
methods.description: Compares two integer values, likely to determine if a client parameter has changed.

methods.name: report_t2
methods.description: Reports an event with a specific type and associated value.

methods.name: get_Clients_Count
methods.description: Retrieves the count of clients based on a specific argument type.

methods.name: get_dml_values
methods.description: Fetches current Data Model Layer (DML) values relevant to the health check.

methods.name: Iscli_Wap_Pass_Changed
methods.description: Checks if the WAP password for a client has changed, compared to an old value.
